moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: Has a chance ([Digit:2digits ]%) of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Screech

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.description: The user takes up a counterattacking posture. Using this move again will cause the user to leave this posture. No other actions can be taken while in this posture. The user will leave this posture if hit by an attack move while it is in this counterattacking posture, then attack the opponent that made the hit. The more damage the user has taken, the greater the power of this attack.

moves.name: Stay Sharp!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user. Applies the Enduring effect to the user. Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ].

passives.name: Grimsley’s Gambit
passives.description:
Makes opponents target the user for a short time when it uses Metal Burst. Grants all of the following effects when the user’s attack move, which was conducted after leaving the counterattacking posture by being hit by an attack move, is successful:
Returns the user’s lowered stats to normal.
Raises the user’s evasiveness by six stat ranks.

passives.name: Full First Aid
passives.description: Fully restores the user’s HP the first time it is in a pinch each battle.
